data.summary: Confirmed the PR 149 audit contract, PR 150 precedence for overlapping managed-field semantics, and direct repair policy.

Audited PR #149 against the approved application-execution/UoW design and current master with PR #150 authoritative on overlapping managed-field semantics. Fixed the missing post-STABLE commit-boundary assertion by registering a Hibernate BeforeTransactionCompletionProcess that rejects late provider dirtiness, queued actions, pending intents, Domain Events, and Integration Event attachments. Added H2 regressions for beforeCompletion entity mutation rollback, late Domain Event rejection, and Query lazy/read-only behavior. Owning module suites pass.

Verification passed: the previously silent post-STABLE beforeCompletion mutation was reproduced, fixed at Hibernate before-transaction-completion, and covered by rollback diagnostics; Query lazy/read-only behavior passed on H2; owning-module suites and full repository check passed; PR #150 managed-field semantics remain authoritative and unchanged.
